e.title: **一个**只做转人工的 MCP**：**两次调用 ＋ 确认令牌 ＋ 邮件点确认，**才让服务商看到你****：MCP 注册处 `com.freightinsurancecost/site` 与 `com.marineinsurancecost/site`（**均 **2026-09-06****）——**⭐ 本次**实测调用**后取回三个工具**，**其标题逐字为**「**not a purchase, not a guaranteed quote**」**；**⭐ 而一步返回的机器可读字段逐字带** `not_a_purchase: true` 与 `quote_guaranteed: false`**；**⭐ 并逐字写下**别信摘要、**包括这一份****（**「**read the bill of lading rather than relying on any summary, including this one**」**）**；**⚠️ 而其登记处指向的仓库**实测 **404****
e.title_en: Two registry-listed servers whose only job is to hand a person to a human broker, returning a machine-readable statement that this is not a purchase and no quote is guaranteed, requiring a two-step call with a confirmation token and an emailed link before any provider sees anything, and telling readers to consult the bill of lading rather than trusting any summary including its own.

e.summary: **enquiry-consent-mcp**（MCP 注册处 **`com.freightinsurancecost/site`** 与 **`com.marineinsurancecost/site`**）**是两个**只做「**转人工**」的货运与海运保险询价 MCP****——**本次实测**：**两条记录均在 **2026-09-06** 发布**、**版本 **1.0.0**、**状态 **active**、**远程端点分别为** `https://freightinsurancecost.com/mcp` 与** `https://marineinsurancecost.com/mcp`**，**且**两条记录**都指向同一个仓库地址**。**⭐ 本次**实际调用**（**握手 ＋ **工具清单 ＋ **两个只读工具**）**，**取回的工具逐字为** `enquiry_describe`、`enquiry_fields`、`submit_enquiry`**，**其标题逐字为**「**What you get: an ENQUIRY with a human (not a purchase, not a guaranteed quote)**」**。**⭐⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**注册处里的东西：调用一次才算数**」**。**⭐⭐⭐ 四处最值得看**：**① **机器可读地声明「**不是购买、**不保证报价**」**；**② **提交要**两次调用 ＋ 确认令牌**，**而**服务商**要等你**点邮件里的链接**才看得到资料**；**③ **它逐字劝你别信摘要、**包括它自己那份**（**并指向提单**）**；**④ **它逐字说明**为什么不登价格****。**⚠️ 而**登记处指向的仓库地址实测 **404****。
e.summary_hk: **enquiry-consent-mcp**（MCP 註冊處 **`com.freightinsurancecost/site`** 與 **`com.marineinsurancecost/site`**）**是兩個**只做「**轉人工**」的貨運與海運保險詢價 MCP****——**本次實測**：**兩條記錄均在 2026-09-06 發布**、**版本 1.0.0**、**狀態 active**、**遠端端點分別為** `https://freightinsurancecost.com/mcp` 與 `https://marineinsurancecost.com/mcp`**，**且**兩條記錄**都指向同一個倉庫地址**。**⭐ 本次**實際調用**（握手＋工具清單＋兩個只讀工具**）**，**取回工具逐字為** `enquiry_describe`、`enquiry_fields`、`submit_enquiry`**。**⭐⭐ 本條目屬於本輪主題**「**註冊處裡的東西：調用一次才算數**」**。**⭐⭐⭐ 四處最值得看**：**① **機器可讀地聲明「**不是購買、**不保證報價**」**；**② **提交要**兩次調用＋確認令牌**，**服務商要等你點郵件連結才看得到資料**；**③ **它逐字勸你別信摘要、**包括它自己那份****；**④ **它逐字說明**為什麼不登價格****。**⚠️ 登記處指向的倉庫位址實測 404****。
e.summary_en: The two registry entries enquiry-consent-mcp **are freight and marine insurance enquiry servers whose only function is to hand a person to a human broker**, both published on the same day in September, both at version 1.0.0 and active, each with a remote endpoint on its own domain, and both pointing at the same repository address which was measured to return not found. **This round completed a handshake, retrieved the tool list and called two read-only tools**, obtaining three tools whose collective title states that what you get is an enquiry with a human rather than a purchase and not a guaranteed quote. **This entry belongs to the round theme of registry contents, where only a call counts**, and **four things are worth reading: the machine-readable statement that this is not a purchase and no quote is guaranteed; a two-step submission with a confirmation token and an emailed link that a provider must wait for; a sentence telling readers to consult the bill of lading rather than trusting any summary including its own; and a sentence explaining why no price appears on the site at all**. **The repository address named by the registry was measured to return not found.**
e.body:
**enquiry-consent-mcp**（MCP 注册处 **`com.freightinsurancecost/site`** 与 **`com.marineinsurancecost/site`**）**是两个**只做「**转人工**」的货运与海运保险询价 MCP****——**本次实测**：**两条记录均在 **2026-09-06** 发布**（**逐字为** `2026-09-06T21:11:10Z` 与** `2026-09-06T21:22:14Z`**）**、**版本 **1.0.0**、**状态 **active**、**远程端点逐字为** `https://freightinsurancecost.com/mcp` **与** `https://marineinsurancecost.com/mcp`**，**且**两条记录**都指向**同一个仓库地址** `https://github.com/joeetdev/venture-estate`**。**⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**注册处里的东西：调用一次才算数**」**。

**可核实信息（均注册处元数据与本次实测调用所得）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 登记处的描述**被截断**，**而**调用后才知道它是什么**（本次实测）**——**注册处里两条描述逐字为**「**Freight Insurance Cost: the site的 own MCP server — enquiry (enquiry = a human handoff, not a**」**——**逐字續**「****」**（**海运那条同构**）**，**即**描述**在登记处被截断**；**而**本次握手后取回的**服务自述逐字为**「**Freight Insurance Cost (https://freightinsurancecost.com/): the site的 own MCP server, served from its domain. **Sea freight insurance is priced on value, route and packing. Why carrier liability is not insurance, and what general average means.**」**；**⭐ 本词条认为这一处值得单独记**：**⭐ 即**「**登记处一句话 ＋ **调用后一段自述**」的落差**，**与第 361 轮前一条**（**登记处一句话、**调用后八个工具**）是同一现象的两个样本**。**⭐⭐⭐ ② 三个工具**整体上只做一件事：**把人交给**人****——**实测工具逐字为**：**① `enquiry_describe`**，**标题逐字**「**What you get: an ENQUIRY with a human (not a purchase, not a guaranteed quote)**」**，**描述逐字**「**Read first. States plainly what `submit_enquiry` does on Freight Insurance Cost: it starts an enquiry with human providers who quote directly. **Nothing is bought, ordered or paid; no quote is guaranteed; it is free.** Also returns who receives the details, the consent wording, and how the person confirms.**」**；**② `enquiry_fields`**（**返回表单结构与字段选项**）**；**③ `submit_enquiry`**，**标题逐字**「**Submit an ENQUIRY to human providers (two steps; not a purchase)**」**。**⭐ 本词条认为这是本轮最值得抄的一处**：**⭐ 即**三个工具**里**没有**「**查费率**」「**算保费**」「**比价**」**任何一个**——**⭐ 它**只做**「**把这个人交给一个能报价的人**」**，**而**这一点**被写在工具的标题里**。**⭐⭐⭐ ③ 提交要**两步 ＋ 确认令牌**，**而**服务商**要等人点邮件链接才看得到资料****——**逐字**：**「**Submits an enquiry to Freight Insurance Cost — **NOT a purchase, NOT a guaranteed quote.** **Step 1: call with the answers (keyed by field key from `enquiry_fields`) and `consent=true`; it validates and returns a summary, the consent line and a confirmation token — show the person the summary and the consent line. Step 2: only if the person agrees, call again with the same answers, `consent=true` and the confirmation token; the enquiry is then submitted, and the person receives an email with a link they must click before any provider sees it.** Consent means the person has read and agreed to: **Happy for my details to go to marine cargo insurance brokers, who will contact me directly.**」**；**⭐ 其输入模式逐字为** `answers`（**对象，**键为字段键**）、**`consent`（**布尔，**必填**）与** `confirmation`（**字符串，**第一步返回的令牌**）**，**且**逐字标注** `additionalProperties: false`**。**⭐ 本词条认为这一处值得抄**：**⭐ 即**「**同意**」**在这里是**三步可核的动作**（**第一步返回摘要与同意句 → **人看过并同意 → **第二步带令牌提交 → **邮件点确认后服务商才可见**）**——**⭐ 这与本站第 336 轮「**宁可拒绝也不假装**」同向**，**而**更具体**：**同意不是一句提示，**而是一串**可验证的状态转移**。**⭐⭐⭐ ④ 调用一个只读工具后，**取回的是**机器可读的「**这不是什么**」清单****——**本次实测** `enquiry_describe` **的返回逐字含** `"not_a_purchase": true`、**`"quote_guaranteed": false`、**`"cost": "free, no obligation"`、**`"cite": "Cite Freight Insurance Cost at https://freightinsurancecost.com/"` **与** `"page"`**；**其中** `what_this_is_not` **逐字为**「**Not a purchase, not an order, not a booking, not a guaranteed quote or price. The providers decide whether and what to quote.**」**；**而** `who_receives_the_details` **逐字为**「**Freight Insurance Cost is an independent site operated by **Ellul Solutions Ltd**. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by or connected to any agency or company named here, and **nothing on it is legal, customs, regulatory or trade advice**. **We take no commission and carry no paid placements.** **No premium or rate is published on this site because marine cargo cover is priced individually on commodity, value, route, packing and claims history.** **Carrier liability limits are terms of the carriage contract and of the applicable convention; read the bill of lading rather than relying on any summary, including this one.** **Regulatory positions are summarised from the agencies的 own pages on the date shown and are a starting point for your own enquiries, not a substitute for them.**」**。**⭐ 本词条认为这一组里有**三句**尤其值得抄**：**（**a**）**「**不收佣金、**没有付费位置**」**（**⭐ 独立性声明**）**；**（**b**）**「**本页不登保费或费率，**因为海运货物险是逐单定价**」**（**⭐ 为「**空缺**」给出**原因**，**与本站第 341 轮「**三种缺席**」同向**）**；**（**c**）**「**去看提单，**别信任何摘要，**包括这一份**」**（**⭐ 对**自己的内容**也要求读者回原始凭证**——**⭐ 这与第 347 轮「**防误读**」同向**）**。**⭐⭐ ⑤ 表单结构可核**——**实测** `enquiry_fields` **返回**标题**「**Get cargo insurance quotes**」**与**逐字段定义**（**键、**标签、**类型、**是否必填、**步骤与选项**）**；**⭐ 本次读到的前三项逐字为**：**`goods`（**必填，**选项含** General manufactured goods／**Electronics or high value／**Food or perishables／**Chemicals or hazardous／**Machinery or vehicles**）、**`value`（**必填，**选项含** Under $25,000／**$25,000 to $100,000／**$100,000 to $500,000／**Over $500,000**）与** `packing`（**选填，**选项含** Full container, palletised／**Full container, loose／**Less than container load**）**。**⭐ 即**询价表单**的每个字段**都能被调用方**先取回再决定怎么问**。**⭐⭐ ⑥ 一处**登记处与现实的落差**（本次实测）**——**两条记录逐字给出的仓库地址均为** `https://github.com/joeetdev/venture-estate`**，**而**该地址**实测返回 **404****（**仓库页与原始文件均不可得**）**；**⭐ 本词条**如实记录**，**并指出**这与第 360／361 轮反复出现的**「**登记处的字段不一定可用**」同向**。**⭐⭐ ⑦ 运营主体被写明**——**逐字**「**operated by **Ellul Solutions Ltd****」**；**⭐ 而**同族的 **npm 包**（**见下一条条目**）**的**维护者**与之**同名**（**`ellul-estate`**）**——**⭐ 本词条**只并列这一事实**，**不推断二者关系**。**⭐⭐ ⑧ 与池内条目的关系**：**本站 [[pingpoint-freight-mcp]]、**[[seaworthy-mcp]]、**[[blueeconomy-marine-insurance]] 覆盖货运与海运保险一侧**，**[[insuranceoracle]]、**[[property-hazard-mcp]]、**[[root-insurance-mcp]] 覆盖面向 Agent 的保险服务**，**[[insurance-governance]]、**[[insurance-fairness-ldp]] 覆盖数据治理与公平性**——**⭐ 而本条补上的是**「**只做转人工的询价 MCP：**机器可读声明不是购买、**两步提交带确认令牌、**邮件点确认后服务商才可见、**并逐字劝读者回原始凭证**」这一形态**；**⭐ 本词条**不对以上任何一条做代码级比较****。

**对 RIAA**：**本条与 [[insurance-governance]]、[[pingpoint-freight-mcp]] 应当并读**；**⭐ 而对本词条项目最有借鉴的五点**：**① 把「**我不是什么**」做成**机器可读字段**（**`not_a_purchase`／**`quote_guaranteed`**）**；**② **同意拆成可验证的状态转移**（**摘要 → **令牌 → **邮件确认**）**；**③ **空缺要给原因**（**为什么这里没有价格**）**；**④ **对读者说清「**别只信我这份摘要**」，**并指向原始凭证**；**⑤ **登记处里的仓库地址要实地打开一次**。

**⚠️ 本词条如实标注**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次**只做了握手、**工具清单与两个只读工具调用**（**`enquiry_describe` 与 `enquiry_fields`**）**，**未调用** `submit_enquiry`**、**未提交任何货物、**金额、**路线或联系方式、**也未勾选任何同意**——**故**不主张**该提交流程的实际行为**（**包括令牌校验、**邮件与可见性时序**）**。**② ⚠️⚠️ 本次**只详细调用了货运那一个端点**（**海运那一个只取回工具清单**）**——**⚠️ 故**两者工具与表单是否完全一致**本次**未逐项核对**。**⚠️ 本条目最需后续核实的一处**。**③ ⚠️ **登记处指向的仓库实测为 404****，**故**本次**无法读其源码或 README**——**⭐ 本词条所述一切**都来自**注册处元数据与端点返回**。**④ ⚠️ 未核实** `Ellul Solutions Ltd` **的注册信息、**营业地址与**监管状态**；**也未核实**其**与任何经纪或保险公司**的关系**（**⭐ 描述逐字声明**无关联、**无背书**）**。**⑤ ⚠️ 未核实**「**不收佣金、**没有付费位置**」**这一独立性声明的**真实性**（**⭐ 本次**只能记录其自述**）**。**⑥ ⚠️ 未核实**其**监管立场摘要**的实际来源与日期标注**（**⭐ 描述称**取自各机构自身页面并标注日期**）**。**⑦ ⚠️ 未核实**同族**第三个服务**（`com.damagerestorehq/claims-index`）**与本条两个**是否**共用同一套实现**（**⭐ 本词条**只并列它们**指向同一仓库地址**这一事实**）**。**⑧ ⚠️ 本条目的**窗口状况**：**两条记录发布于 **2026-09-06**（**在解冻窗口之内**）**——**⭐ 无需窗口例外说明**。**⑨ ⚠️ 本条目所记为 2026-09-11 所见**；**⚠️ 并如实提示**：**该服务**不是**购买、**不是报价**、**也不是法律或海关意见**（**⭐ 这些话都是服务自己写的**）**，**不得**当作任何投保或费率依据**。

e.body_en:
The two registry entries enquiry-consent-mcp, both published on the same day in September, both at version 1.0.0 and active, each with a remote endpoint on its own domain, and both naming the same repository address, **are freight and marine insurance enquiry servers whose only job is to hand a person to a human broker**. **This entry belongs to the round theme of registry contents, where only a call counts.**

**Verified information, all measured from the registry metadata and the call made this round**: **first, the registry description is truncated, and only a call reveals what the server is**: the registry text stops with the phrase about an enquiry being a human handoff, while the handshake returns the server own summary stating that sea freight insurance is priced on value, route and packing and that the server explains why carrier liability is not insurance and what general average means. **A one-line registry entry and a paragraph of self-description after a call is the same gap seen in the previous entry of this round.** **Second, all three tools do one thing, which is to move a person to a person**: verbatim, the describing tool is titled as what you get being an enquiry with a human rather than a purchase and not a guaranteed quote, and its description says to read it first, states plainly that the submission tool starts an enquiry with human providers who quote directly, that nothing is bought, ordered or paid, that no quote is guaranteed and that it is free, and that it also returns who receives the details, the consent wording and how the person confirms; a second tool returns the enquiry form structure; and the third is titled as submitting an enquiry to human providers in two steps, not a purchase. **None of the three tools looks up a rate, computes a premium or compares prices; the whole server is a handoff, and that is stated in the tool titles.** **Third, submission takes two calls plus a confirmation token, and a provider sees nothing until the person clicks an emailed link**: verbatim, the first step takes the answers and a consent flag, validates them and returns a summary, the consent line and a confirmation token which are to be shown to the person, and the second step is made only if the person agrees, with the same answers, the consent flag and the token, after which the enquiry is submitted and the person receives an email with a link they must click before any provider sees it; consent means the person has read and agreed to the provided sentence about their details going to cargo insurance brokers who will contact them directly. The input schema marks the consent flag as required and forbids additional properties. **Consent is therefore a chain of verifiable state transitions rather than a prompt: a returned summary and consent sentence, a person who agrees, a second call carrying the token, and an emailed confirmation before any provider gains visibility.** **Fourth, a read-only call returns a machine-readable list of what this is not**: the measured response includes flags stating that this is not a purchase and that no quote is guaranteed, along with the cost described as free and with no obligation, a citation line and a page address; a field stating that this is not a purchase, not an order, not a booking and not a guaranteed quote or price, and that the providers decide whether and what to quote; and a field naming the operator as a limited company, stating that the site is not affiliated with, endorsed by or connected to any agency or company named on it and that nothing on it is legal, customs, regulatory or trade advice, that the operator takes no commission and carries no paid placements, that no premium or rate is published because marine cargo cover is priced individually on commodity, value, route, packing and claims history, that carrier liability limits are terms of the carriage contract and of the applicable convention so the bill of lading should be read rather than any summary including this one, and that regulatory positions are summarised from the agencies own pages on the date shown and are a starting point rather than a substitute. **Three of those sentences are worth copying: no commission and no paid placements as an independence statement; an explicit reason for an absence, namely why no price appears here; and an instruction to the reader to go back to the original document rather than trusting this summary, including its own.** **Fifth, the form structure is retrievable**: the fields tool returns a form title and per-field definitions with keys, labels, types, whether required, step and options, the first three measured being a required cargo type selection, a required shipment value band selection and an optional packing selection. **Sixth, one gap between the registry and reality was measured**: both records name the same repository address, and that address was measured to return not found, so no source or readme could be read. **Seventh, the operator is named in the response**, and the maintainer name of the sibling package described in the next entry of this round matches it; **this entry records the fact without inferring a relationship**. **Eighth, relative to existing entries**: pooled entries cover freight and marine insurance material, agent-facing insurance services, and insurance data governance and fairness, **while this entry supplies enquiry servers that do nothing but hand a person to a human, declare in machine-readable form that this is not a purchase, require a two-step submission with a token and an emailed confirmation before any provider sees anything, and instruct the reader to consult the original document rather than any summary including their own. This entry makes no code-level comparison against any of them.**

**For RIAA**: **this entry reads alongside the pooled insurance governance entry and the pooled freight insurance entry**; **five practices transfer directly: make what you are not into machine-readable fields; split consent into verifiable state transitions; give a reason for an absence rather than leaving a blank; tell the reader not to trust your own summary and point at the original document; and actually open any repository address a registry names**.

**Marked honestly by this entry**: **first, only a handshake, a tool list and two read-only tool calls were made**, with the submission tool never called, no cargo, value, route or contact details submitted and no consent flag set, **so the actual behaviour of the submission flow, including token validation, email delivery and visibility timing, is not claimed**. **Second, only the freight endpoint was explored in detail**, the marine one yielding only a tool list, **so whether the two are identical in tools and form was not checked field by field**; **this is the item most in need of later verification**. **Third, the repository address named by the registry was measured to return not found, so no source code or readme could be read**, and everything stated here comes from registry metadata and endpoint responses. **Fourth, the registration, address and regulatory status of the named operating company were not verified, nor was its relationship to any broker or insurer, the response stating that it has none.** **Fifth, the accuracy of the independence claim about taking no commission and carrying no paid placements was not verified**, only recorded as a self-description. **Sixth, the actual sources and date stamps behind its regulatory summary were not verified. Seventh, whether the third server in the same family shares one implementation with these two was not verified**, this entry recording only that they name the same repository address. **Eighth, on the window: both records were published 2026-09-06, inside the thaw window, so there is no window exception to declare. Ninth, this entry records what was visible on 2026-09-11, and states plainly that the service is neither a purchase nor a quote nor legal or customs advice, as the service itself says, and must not be used as a basis for any application or rate.**
